t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in specific pairs, although not in the same order two colours will always appear together.Some colours including red, blue and orange lead to a bright coloured foest and the other colours including purple and brown lead to dark coloured forest. I will have to work out which forests have the most mushrooms to collect

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in pairs - orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow and blue and purple. The orange, green, red and blue lead to a bright foest and a red basket and the rest of the colours lead to a dark forest with a yellow basket.The number of mushrooms you can gather changed each time. Be aware that just because you get a high number of mushrooms once, doesn't mean you will the second time. Additionally, you may get a high number of mushrooms, but the other colour may have given you more.Try to remember the amount of numbers a colour gives you consistently. The gnomes are always grouped in the same pairs, so this shpuld help you keep track.The size and shape of the gnomes don't relate to the number of mushrooms you can gather, so focus only on the colours.
